question: Who sang the song i'm coming out?

The song has been sampled numerous times, including by Stevie J and Keyshia Cole [3].

The lithosphere is further divided into the crust, which is broken up into several large plates that float on the more fluid mantle [1]. The Earth also has a solid inner core at its center, which is surrounded by a liquid outer core [2][3]. The inner core is solid due to the immense pressure at its depth.
